real_errors.title: AGENTS section 2.5: current safety statements still give figures that rest on inferred inputs as 'Calculation' or bare model output, and four round 28 status lines claim every such figure is labelled
real_errors.evidence: Reproduced. ESD: 1.2 uC / 220 nF + 2.032 V = 7.49 V nominal; 1.2 uC / (0.72 x 220 nF) + 2.063 V = 9.65 V ('about 9.6 V'); the 0.72 x minimum carries the X7R DC-bias allowance that D-R19-10 (R10_DECISIONS.md:2997) labels Inference, and the full charge transfer is an assumption; M3_R10.md:455-457 and ORDERING.md:651 label the same figures Inference, FMEA:37 and REQUIREMENTS:64 do not. C128's 991 microstrain is 'Calculation/Inference' at R10_VALIDATION.md:2534 and '(R21-SAF-03, Inference)' in owner row 1, bare 'plate model' at FMEA:38. Fire budget: Q124's inherited hot factor is an Inference (parts_qualification.md:490; M3_R10.md:650 'Calculation / Inference'), but R10_VALIDATION.md:2642-2647 gives 1.540851 ... 1.278747 A with only 'the stated ... assumptions'. Watchdog guard: AGENTS.md:25 and the binding note say 'Calculation on allocations / Inference' (gate-discharge model's 0.4 V criterion and hot gate charge inferred); R10_VALIDATION.md:2712-2714 says 'calculated 34.853 ms' and owner row 7 (R10_VALIDATION.md:2369) titles the 20 ms firing and the guard 'calculations'. Plate model 125 / 133 g in owner row 32 (R10_VALIDATION.md:2404) is unlabelled while ORDERING.md:702 labels it Calculation/Inference. Sweep additions: M3_R10.md:415-418 gives the 3V3-to-gate-net bridge as '(about 3.23 V ...; Calculation)', but its premise (a hard 3V3 bridge holds PE4's net at 3.3 V against PE4's low driver) is labelled Inference at FMEA:39 and R10_VALIDATION.md:2569; STATUS.md:26 and R10_VALIDATION.md:2346 call the four-stall pack sag 'Calculations on the budget model', while its owning record parts_qualification.md:693 heads it 'Inference, stall input' and the round 27 records (STATUS.md:37, R10_VALIDATION.md:2269) say 'Calculations / Inferences'. Scanner (.supervisor/r29_triage/labelscan.py, 448 hits over the scoped current text, block- and heading-aware, then read by hand): every other current statement of the EN-timing, chatter, hold-up, cold-screen, Q122-drive, fire-budget, plate, thermal, ESD, gate-fight and port-lead figures is labelled in its sentence, its row or bullet, or its section heading. The status claims at AGENTS.md:32, M3_R10.md:32-34, M3_R10.md:182 and STATUS.md:18 are therefore false.

real_errors.title: Firmware rule 3 gives Q124's gate time constant as 47-53 us; that range covers C126 from -10 % to nominal only, and the fitted part's +10 % gives about 58 us
real_errors.evidence: C126 is CL10B224KA8NNNC (m3_bom_jlc.csv:15, C21120; tolerance code K = +/-10 %). Source model (round23_safety_severity_check.md:68): R = (220 + 50||50||1000) || 10000 = 238.6 ohm, Ciss 2.25 nF. Recomputed: -10 % 47.8 us, nominal 53.0 us, +10 % 58.3 us; over the source's driver range the envelope is about 45-61 us. The source itself states only '-10 % plus Ciss' and nominal; the docs present 47-53 us as the range. Sweep of the safety / firmware text for other ranges that cover part of a part's tolerance: none found. C87 0.72-1.27 x, C120's 1.265 uF maximum in the 31.9 ms, the LSI range in 28.571-32.653 ms, the PA6 window and R84's tolerance cover their full ranges; the 0.218 V and 0.104 V pull-up bounds are nominal-resistor figures (0.2203 / 0.1048 V with 1 % parts), already ruled observations (R28-POWER obs 2, R19-DOC-05); the 7.1 us and 0.91 kOhm figures are stated as nominal ('about').

real_errors.title: LS120 (MLT-5020) is rated -20...+70 C operating, so at the stated 70 C bay it is out of rating, and the hot-end disposition, the 55 C interim limit and the chamber test cover only 85 C parts
real_errors.evidence: Huawha MLT-5020 specification p2 item 6 (cached .supervisor/r14_parts_pdf/buzzer.pdf, SHA-256 db73c860..., the sheet the M1 row cites for reflow): operating -20~+70 C, SPL >= 75 dB; storage -30~+85 C (item 7). LS120 is fitted (JLC BOM C94598, F(23,58.5)); F11 makes it the pad and post-landing annunciator. The Temperature row's own board rise, +10-22 K at the pad load (Inference), puts LS120 at 80-92 C in a 70 C bay and 65-77 C at the 55 C interim limit; the row's logic for 85 C parts (85 - 22 ~ 60 C) gives about 48 C bay air for a 70 C part. The chamber test passes on 'every 85 C part <= 85 C' and never checks LS120. Parts rated below 85 C at the hot end: LS120 (+70 C) and J3 (+80 C, disclosed as unmated in flight, parts_qualification.md:46 and REQUIREMENTS:94; not counted). Every other fitted part is rated +85 C or wider per the records. No round 24-28 triage observation covers LS120's hot end.
